app: unsigned v0.8 local no-preload control, product commit 4f7c05ba0bb127b0c8a97def65915efdc57f2a3c
interpretation: The local extension-host start awaited the shell-environment promise for 161 ms in this one launch, including 107 ms after host allocation. This is only a possible overlap opportunity, not a measured speed gain or proof that bootstrap can safely proceed before the final environment is available.
reportLimitation: The Startup Performance report copies main-process marks from the window configuration at creation. Its main section ended at code/willOpenNewWindow, before shell resolution completed. Delaying perfview.show by 2000 ms therefore did not expose code/didResolveShellEnv. The renderer's didResolveExtensionHostShellEnv mark includes the IPC promise resolution and is not the exact main-process shell-completion timestamp.
